description: This file defines the PutObjectUrlMiddleware class, which is a part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the S3 service. It acts as middleware to inject ObjectURL information into the result of S3 PutObject-related operations.

classes.name: PutObjectUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for augmenting S3 operation results with ObjectURL information.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that returns an instance of PutObjectUrlMiddleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a callable for the next handler in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, modifying the command result to include ObjectURL based on operation type.
